---
title: Calendar
format:
  html:
    include-in-header: assets/calendar/calendar-head.html
    css: assets/calendar/calendar.css
---

This calendar is generated directly from the course schedule in `course.yml`.

<div id="calendar-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading the course schedule…</div>
<div id="ec" aria-label="Machine Learning for Big Data course calendar"></div>

<dialog id="event-details" class="calendar-dialog" aria-labelledby="event-details-title">
  <div class="calendar-dialog-header">
    <h2 id="event-details-title"></h2>
    <button type="button" class="calendar-dialog-close" aria-label="Close event details">×</button>
  </div>
  <div id="event-details-body"></div>
</dialog>

<script src="assets/calendar/calendar.js"></script>
